title: H187 — The Moving Target
chapter: XLIX — When the Answer Arrives Late
response_rule: Probe sampled at request time and returned after specified latency.
timestamp_gate: Discard reply if a trustworthy change event has timestamp strictly after sample and at or before arrival.
limitations: Perfect externally supplied change-event timestamps are assumed only for the timestamp policy
Unannounced changes cannot be detected with timestamps alone
No sensor noise or probabilistic change detection is modeled
Synthetic cost penalty is not joules
The H187 poster contains invented conceptual figures 2,592 and 99.2% inconsistent with executed sweep; verified results supersede it
No physical demonstration of Rupert/CMB/CMD energy mechanism
